interventions.title: Install Raised Curb

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Implement a planting strip or furniture zone with street trees to create a psychological and physical buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks with appropriate signage to provide a designated space for pedestrians to cross.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer / Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or furniture zone with street trees to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Utility Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate utility poles to the edge of the sidewalk or underground them to clear the pedestrian path of travel.

interventions.title: Street Trees

interventions.description: Implement speed humps or lane narrowing to reduce vehicle speeds on this straight stretch of road.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and reduce the overall unprotected crossing distance.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Add a buffer zone with street trees between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical protection and visually narrow the street to encourage slower speeds.
